look_here_first: Look at the leaves before the flower: a low, essentially trunkless colony with flexible dark-green leaves that twist helically and have wavy/denticulate orange to reddish-brown margins.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flexible lanceolate leaves, 35–60 cm long and 1.7–4 cm wide

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves conspicuously twisted and strongly concave

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaf margins wavy or minutely toothed, dark orange to reddish brown

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: inflorescence rises well beyond the rosette

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruit erect, dry, dehiscent capsule rather than a fleshy berry

key_traits.label: Joey field note
key_traits.text: Joey's landscaping frame gives a clear whole-rosette view and leaf architecture. Use the low basal rosette and visibly twisting blades as the immediate field gestalt, then confirm the orange-to-reddish wavy/denticulate margins.
